{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./eeglab_120.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --time=00:10:00      -> -t 10m
#   --ntasks=1           -> -n 1
#   --cpus-per-task=1    -> -c 1
#   --array=2500-2508    -> submit 9 jobs (best-effort via flux submit --cc)

# NOTE: Slurm --mem-per-cpu=4096 not translated.
# Performance implication: without a per-core memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

# NOTE: Slurm --partition=bigmem not translated.
# Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the bigmem partition.

# NOTE: Slurm --hint=nomultithread not translated.
# Performance implication: without disabling SMT/HT explicitly, the job may share physical cores via hyperthreading, potentially impacting performance.

# NOTE: Slurm --account=uoa00424 not translated.
# Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name and --mail-* not translated.
# Performance implication: none; operational implication: job naming and email notifications not provided.

START=2500
END=2508
COUNT=$((END-START+1))

# Submit as N independent jobs; use FLUX_TASK_RANK (0..COUNT-1) to emulate array index.
flux submit --cc=${COUNT} -N 1 -n 1 -c 1 -t 10m \
  bash -lc '
    IDX=${FLUX_TASK_RANK:-0}
    SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID=$(( '"$START"' + IDX ))

    # No exact Slurm SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID equivalent; use Flux jobid for uniqueness.
    SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID=${FLUX_JOB_ID:-0}

    module load MATLAB/2017b

    flux run -n 1 -c 1 matlab -nodesktop -nosplash -r EEGlab_120_PreProcessed_v3 ${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID} ${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}
  '
"
}

{
  "valid": true,
  "tool_call": false,

  ],
  "tool_call": false
